tiebreakers.description: Tied player holding the Monkey Trophy Card wins
If no tied player holds the Monkey Trophy Card, victory is shared.

notes: family: abstract-objective. Banana Points per Monkey Card are printed on the cards (entered as one sum). Game end triggered when the brick tray lacks enough bricks of one kind for a player at end of their turn; the round is finished so all have equal turns. Butterfly and Frog trophies are optional rules.
